title: PICLas archived REF_DSMC neutral-species VHS inputs
notes: Mass, dref and Tref retain source SI values. Atlas viscosity_index = PICLas omega + 0.5; alpha = 1 for VHS.
Archived reference inputs, not a universal calibrated database. No temperature fit ranges are specified.
The source's inconsistent Xe species numbering and charged species are excluded.

title: SPARTA air VSS reference inputs
notes: Collision coefficients and masses come from matching air files; SI values retained.
Only neutral species and elastic coefficients are included. No fit temperature interval specified.

title: SPARTA Mars/Venus VSS reference inputs
notes: Matching species and collision files; SI values retained.
SPARTA attributes collision parameters to Swaminathan-Gopalan (2015). No fit temperature interval specified.
Relaxation and reaction coefficients are not imported.

title: SPARTA independent argon VHS and VSS reference inputs
notes: Each model retains its own reference diameter; masses use ar.species.

title: Weaver and Alexeenko (2015), revised pure-gas VSS fits
notes: Table 1 d_ref in angstrom is multiplied by 1e-10; omega, alpha, T_ref and per-gas fit intervals are retained.
Masses are separately taken from the pinned PICLas reference input, not from this paper.
The included subset is H2, He, N2, O2 and Ar. These are self-collision fits, not unlike-species fits.
